shared_elements: human figure (profile procession in A; single frontal anthropomorphic form in B)
justification: The only correspondences are generic: both depict the human form and both include disc/concentric-circle motifs, elements almost any tradition might produce. A shows dense registers of naturalistic profile figures in procession leading animals, while B is a single massive frontal schematic figure whose surface carries isolated abstract rings and arcs, with no narrative relationships at all.
